mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (monetary easing) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in inflation (CPIAUCSL rising more than 0.3 percentage points over three months) signals an impending monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods following a CPIAUCSL rise > 0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment growth (PAYEMS rising) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE falling) signals a tight labor market that fuels wage inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods following simultaneous PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, housing starts (HOUST) above its 12-month average signal robust demand that supports corporate revenue growth without immediate rate hikes, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO falling more than 1.0 percentage point over three months) signals an economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods following an INDPRO decline > 1.0% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods following a UNRATE below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 300), a higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 300 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.
